verdict.rationale: Godot's headless CLI mode and EditorScript/plugin system let scripts run without the GUI (e.g., for CI builds/exports), which can be wired into external schedulers or automation pipelines, but there is no built-in agent/automation-scheduling framework or AI-native background-task system documented. missing for 10: native scheduling/trigger system, evidence of persistent background agents, AI-specific automation hooks, independent confirmation of autonomous unattended runs beyond CI export scripts.
